name: Clean Hands
description: Complete the Prologue without firing a weapon.
guide: The Prologue can be finished without pulling the trigger: the guards in the lobby can be slipped past while the alarm is still off, and the escape car has a clear run if you take the service tunnel. Any shot fired voids the trophy even if it hits nothing. Because the Prologue has no mission replay, a botched run means starting a new save, so play it patiently the first time.
why: The opening mission has no replay option, so one noisy mistake locks the trophy out for that save.
steps: Move through the lobby without firing on the guards.
Take the service tunnel during the escape.
Reach the extraction point with a full magazine.

name: Ambrosia Angler
description: Catch every fish species in the Ambrosia creek.
guide: Eight species live in and around the Ambrosia creek, and the ranger station posts a checklist once you buy a rod from the tackle shop. Two of them only bite at dawn, and the gar refuses anything but live bait, which the shop sells after the second story mission. Fish the deep pool under the bridge last, since that is where the record catfish spawns.
why: It is a region-locked species checklist with time-of-day and bait conditions on several entries.
steps: Buy a rod and the species checklist in Ambrosia.
Fish the creek at dawn and dusk for the rare species.
Land all eight species and confirm the checklist.

name: Small Town Sat Nav
description: Discover every named location in Ambrosia.
guide: Ambrosia holds fourteen named locations, from the diner and the motel to the boat ramp and the water tower, and each only clears its map fog when you drive or walk close enough. Flying over them does not count. Sweep the town in a slow circuit after each story mission, because a few locations only appear once the plot visits them.
why: It is pure map coverage in a small area, and several spots stay hidden until the story passes through.
steps: Drive a slow loop through Ambrosia town centre.
Visit the outlying boat ramp and water tower.
Check the map for any remaining grey patches.

name: Swamp Justice
description: Complete every story mission in Grassrivers.
guide: The Grassrivers chain runs from the airboat introduction to the courthouse standoff, and the trophy lands when the last mission's results screen closes. Two of the missions hand you a boat and a rifle respectively, so keep both maintained. There are no optional objectives tied to the award.
why: It is the only story-completion trophy for the Grassrivers act, which the campaign otherwise skips past quickly.
steps: Start the chain with the airboat introduction.
Complete every Grassrivers story mission in order.
Finish the courthouse standoff mission.

name: Mud Bug
description: Win the Grassrivers swamp buggy race.
guide: The buggy race runs a single long lap through flooded tracks, and the AI takes the deep water lines that bog a stock vehicle down. Fit the snorkel upgrade before entering, then hug the shallow bank on the two river crossings. It unlocks from the activity menu after the third Grassrivers mission and stays replayable in free roam.
why: The course punishes an unmodified buggy, so winning needs preparation rather than luck.
steps: Unlock the buggy race after the third Grassrivers mission.
Fit the snorkel and off-road tyres.
Win the lap while staying on the shallow line.

name: Stevedore
description: Win every bout in the Port Gellhorn dockyard fight club.
guide: The fight club runs five bouts behind the container yard warehouse, and each opponent switches style: the first two brawl, the third grapples, and the last two use weapons. Blocking beats dodging in the tight ring, and the fence line counts as a ring-out. Bouts are replayable one at a time from the activity menu, so losing the last fight does not reset the earlier wins.
why: Five escalating hand-to-hand bouts with weapon rules make it more than a story beat.
steps: Find the fight club behind the container yard warehouse.
Win the three unarmed bouts.
Beat the final two armed opponents without a ring-out.

name: Night Shift
description: Complete ten Port Gellhorn smuggling runs.
guide: Smuggling runs only appear after dark and each one asks you to move a crate from the docks to a drop point without a police escort finding it. The radar van patrols the main road, so take the back lanes past the fish market. Only successful drops advance the counter, and the job board stays open after the story.
why: It is a ten-run night-only grind with a stealth condition on every delivery.
steps: Wait for nightfall and take a run from the dock board.
Use the back lanes to avoid the radar van.
Complete ten successful drops.

name: Deep Six
description: Find the sunken smuggler plane in the Leonida Keys.
guide: A smuggling plane went down off the southern reef and never appears on the map. Look for the oil slick and the floating crate about a kilometre east of the last island, then dive with the rebreather to the wreck at roughly forty metres. The trophy registers when you touch the cockpit, so bring a light and watch your air gauge on the way back up.
why: It is an unmarked underwater wreck that no mission or map icon points toward.
steps: Sail east of the southernmost Keys island.
Find the oil slick and dive with the rebreather.
Touch the cockpit of the wreck.

name: Valet King
description: Park fifteen cars at the Vice City valet job without damaging one.
guide: The valet job sits outside a beach hotel and pays per car, but the trophy only counts clean parks. Scrapes, kerbed alloys and any collision void the current car, though the shift itself never ends. Reverse into the spaces slowly and use the camera rather than the mirrors; fifteen clean cars takes about twenty minutes.
why: The no-damage condition turns a simple driving job into a precise one.
steps: Start a valet shift at the beach hotel.
Park each car without scraping or kerbing it.
Complete fifteen clean parks in one shift.

name: Air Ace
description: Win the Vice City helicopter time trial.
guide: The time trial threads eleven checkpoints between the downtown towers and the beach, and the par time is tight enough that a single wide turn ruins it. Fly the course once at cruise to learn the checkpoint order, then restart and cut the corners close to the buildings. The trial unlocks after the story hands you the helipad safehouse.
why: It is a strict par-time flight through dense airspace, not a simple checkpoint tour.
steps: Unlock the helipad safehouse through the story.
Fly a practice lap to learn the checkpoint order.
Restart and beat the par time.

name: Bounty Hunter
description: Bring in all twelve bail jumpers alive.
guide: Twelve bounty targets appear on the police scanner across Vice City, and each must be restrained rather than killed to count. Most run when spotted, so block their car with your own before closing in. The final target is holed up in a boatyard and calls reinforcements, so bring non-lethal gear and clear the dockhands first.
why: The alive-only rule across twelve targets is stricter than the usual kill-or-capture bounty loop.
steps: Take bounty contracts from the police scanner.
Block and restrain each target without killing them.
Bring in all twelve, including the boatyard target.

name: Crew Contract
description: Complete an online heist with a full crew of four.
guide: Online heists need four players and every role filled, so join a public lobby rather than waiting on friends. The first contract, a warehouse robbery, is the shortest and most forgiving for random matchmaking. Stay in the session until the payout screen closes, because leaving early forfeits the completion credit.
why: It is the only online trophy that requires a coordinated four-player crew to finish a heist.
steps: Join an online heist lobby with four players.
Complete the warehouse contract with every role filled.
Stay through the payout screen.

name: Kalaga Calling
description: Complete the Mount Kalaga story missions.
guide: The mountain arc opens once Vice City hands you the ranger contact and runs through the fire lookout, the radio tower and the cave rescue. The trophy awards at the end of the cave mission, which is the only one with a fail state worth watching for. Bring a rifle for the wildlife sections and keep the park ranger alive.
why: It is the shortest story arc in the game and the only one set entirely on the mountain.
steps: Meet the ranger contact after the Vice City arc.
Complete the lookout and radio tower missions.
Finish the cave rescue with the ranger alive.

name: Moonshiner
description: Deliver ten moonshine loads without breaking a jar.
guide: The still sits off a dirt track outside Whetstone and the buyer changes every run, so learn the two back roads rather than following the GPS onto the highway. Any hard impact breaks jars and voids the load, and the trophy needs ten intact deliveries. Drive the loaner truck gently; it handles poorly when the bed is full.
why: Ten damage-free rural deliveries is a long, fragile grind that rewards patience over speed.
steps: Pick up a load from the Whetstone still.
Drive the back roads to the buyer without hard impacts.
Complete ten intact deliveries.

name: Rodeo Champion
description: Win every event at the Whetstone rodeo.
guide: The rodeo runs four events: bronc riding, barrel racing, calf roping and a stock truck race. Bronc riding is scored on staying mounted for eight seconds, while roping needs two clean throws. The events unlock in order across four in-game days, so plan to return to Whetstone rather than clearing it in one visit.
why: Four different disciplines with their own scoring rules make this the region's toughest activity set.
steps: Enter the rodeo and clear the bronc and barrel events.
Land two clean roping throws.
Win the stock truck race on the final day.

name: Inside Job
description: Complete the Heist using the stealth approach.
guide: Choosing the stealth approach means disabling the alarm, cutting the vault power and leaving without a shot fired until the escape. The setup missions that matter are the security schedule and the camera loop, so finish both before the point of no return. If the alarm trips mid-run you can still finish the heist, but the trophy is gone for that attempt.
why: It requires a fully silent route through the campaign's loudest mission.
steps: Complete the security schedule and camera loop setups.
Enter via the maintenance shaft and cut the vault power.
Leave the building without tripping the alarm.

name: Loose Ends
description: Complete every remaining side story in free roam.
guide: After the credits a handful of character arcs reopen as blue question marks, including the taxi dispatcher, the marina owner and the retired cop. Each is a short three-part chain and none are marked until you drive within a block of the starting location. The pause menu activity list shows how many chains remain, so use it to hunt down the stragglers.
why: It is the only trophy that requires sweeping the whole map for unmarked post-story content.
steps: Finish the story and return to free roam.
Drive near each blue question mark to start its chain.
Complete every remaining side story chain.

name: Leonida Legend
guide: Completion covers story missions, side jobs, collectibles, races, challenges and online, and the stats menu breaks the total down by category. Leave this until the Epilogue, since several activities only spawn after the credits. Work category by category rather than chasing whatever is closest, and recheck the stats screen after each sweep for the last few percent.
why: It is the broadest trophy on the list and touches every activity type in the game.
steps: Finish the story and unlock full free roam.
Clear each completion category listed in the stats menu.
Recheck the stats screen until it reads one hundred percent.
